opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £10,000 to £250,000
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations (charities, trusts, community groups, community/parish councils, community interest companies, faith-based/church organisations, local authorities, other public sector organisations), private owners of a heritage asset, and partnerships.
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £10,000 to £250,000. Funds projects that value, care for and sustain heritage, taking into account four investment principles (saving heritage, protecting the environment, inclusion/access/participation, organisational sustainability). No deadline - open all year round.

opportunities.title: National Lottery Heritage Grants £250,000 to £10million
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Not-for-profit organisations and partnerships led by a not-for-profit organisation (charities, trusts, community groups, community/parish councils, community interest companies, faith-based/church organisations, local authorities, other public sector organisations).
opportunities.summary: Funding programme for all types of heritage projects in the UK, from £250,000 to £10million. Requires an Expression of Interest first, then a development phase and delivery phase. Quarterly application deadlines. For grants under £1m applicants must contribute at least 5% of project costs; for grants over £1m at least 10%.
